description: Add a continuous chokidar-based watcher for .ralph/ that keeps plans/overview-ralph-state.{js,json} fresh in real time, with debounced per-slug incremental re-derivation that preserves cross-kind precedence, a shared sync-lock primitive consumed by both watch and one-shot modes, a Vite plugin auto-start, and downstream cascade refresh of Plans 03-12. Implements Plan 02 of the Ralph pipeline.

planReviewContext.description: deriveAffectedTaskUpdate return type { taskId, newPipelineState | null } conflates 'remove task' with 'keep prior state because JSON parse failed'. The plan elsewhere requires malformed JSON to retain prior entry, but the contract has no variant for that case.
planReviewContext.suggestedFix: Add an explicit result variant. Example: { action: 'upsert' | 'remove' | 'retain', taskId, newPipelineState?, error? }. 'retain' is emitted on parse failure; 'remove' is emitted when no candidates remain on disk.

planReviewContext.description: mergeAndWrite only describes applying byTaskId deltas, but OverviewRalphState also carries unmatched and unmatchedSummary (parse errors, duplicate-resolution, no-match, cross-kind shadowing). Incremental writes will leave those fields stale.
planReviewContext.suggestedFix: Specify that mergeAndWrite recomputes the unmatched + unmatchedSummary slices for the affected taskId(s) before writing, or replaces them with a fresh fragment from assembleStateFromBundles for the touched kind/slug set. Update Acceptance Criterion C to read 'incremental output equals walkRalphState output after normalizing generatedAt' (covers unmatched + unmatchedSummary).

planReviewContext.description: The acceptance criterion 'one-shot pnpm sync-ralph-state fails fast when a fresh watcher lock exists' is asserted but the ordered steps do not add lock handling to scripts/sync-ralph-state.mjs's one-shot path. As written, one-shot calls walkRalphState then writeSidecar with no lock check.
planReviewContext.suggestedFix: Add a shared lock helper (e.g. scripts/lib/sync-lock.mjs) and a new step in Implementation Strategy: 'Wrap the one-shot path in sync-ralph-state.mjs with the shared lock helper so one-shot also acquires the lock before writeSidecar and fails fast on contention with the same diagnostic message.' Add the shared lock helper to Files to Create.

planReviewContext.description: pnpm-lock.yaml is not in the Files to Modify list, but adding chokidar to root devDependencies will require a lockfile update. Without it, frozen-lock installs break.
planReviewContext.suggestedFix: Add 'pnpm-lock.yaml' to the Modify list with a note: 'updated by pnpm install -D chokidar; verify resolved version stays pinned to the current transitive 5.x'.

planReviewContext.description: Stale-lock policy 'mtime > 60s' makes every healthy watcher become 'stale' after 60s, allowing a second watcher to overwrite the lock and run concurrently. The 60s mtime check alone is not safe.
planReviewContext.suggestedFix: Either (a) refresh lock file mtime on every debounce tick (or via a 30s heartbeat timer) AND/OR (b) on detected stale lock, parse the JSON, attempt a PID-liveness check (process.kill(pid, 0) catch ESRCH => stale) before overwriting. Document the chosen mechanism in Architecture + Acceptance Criteria + Test G.

planReviewContext.description: Watcher root description hardcodes config.ralphRoot/jobs, /job-groups, /brainstorms. config.ralphSubdirs supports overrides via scripts/lib/resolve-config.mjs; the watcher must resolve those subdir paths rather than hardcode the names.
planReviewContext.suggestedFix: Replace 'config.ralphRoot/jobs' / '/job-groups' / '/brainstorms' references with the resolved paths from config.ralphSubdirs.jobs / .jobGroups / .brainstorms (joined under config.ralphRoot). Document this in Architecture + Implementation Strategy step 2.

userStories.title: Implement shared sync-lock helper
userStories.description: As the watcher and one-shot CLI, I want a single scripts/lib/sync-lock.mjs module so that lock-file metadata, fresh/stale semantics, and PID-liveness gating are not duplicated and never drift.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/lib/sync-lock.mjs exports acquireLock({ lockPath, processLabel, staleAfterMs }), releaseLock(handle), touchLock(handle); LockHandle exposes release() (ENOENT-tolerant unlink) and touch() (ENOENT-tolerant fs.utimes).
Acquire writes JSON { pid, process, startedAt } with flag 'wx'.
On EEXIST with mtime age < staleAfterMs: throws Error("another sync in progress (pid <N>, process <label>, started <ts>)") with the JSON parsed from disk.

This PRD keeps US-006 as a single story for simplicity; if the implementer chooses to split, both halves MUST land before US-007 — record the choice in notepad.md.

F-013 [Medium]: Closed as duplicate by AC #4 of the plan + Test C as rewritten. Implementer may verify and close without separate action.

F-014 [Medium]: Add a Test K that touches .ralph/brainstorms/<slug>/selected-direction.md and asserts NO pending change is enqueued, deriveAffectedTaskUpdate is NOT called, and onWrite is NOT fired. Spy on onWrite + pendingChanges to verify.

Apply edits in the FINAL commit on the worktree branch (no earlier story commit touches these files).
Commit message lists each diff (file + line range + what changed) so reviewers can verify.
